May God bless our service members, their families, and all who have sacrificed for this country. We owe you everything.

When JFK was president, roughly 1 in 20 American kids were obese. Today, it’s 1 in 5.

This didn’t happen because kids got lazier. It happened because we let ultra-processed foods take over what our children eat every single day.

The MAHA movement is working to bring real food and scratch cooking back into America’s schools. Our kids deserve food to help them grow, learn and thrive.

Make America Healthy Again.

One flag. One allegiance.

The VA spends nearly $1 BILLION every year on software while lacking a complete inventory of what it owns. This leads to duplicate purchases, unused licenses, overbilling, and cybersecurity risks.

Our VAMOSA Act brings basic accountability to VA software spending, cuts the waste, and protects taxpayer dollars.

Taxpayer dollars should go directly to our veterans. Not wasted on software nobody is using and nobody is tracking.
